versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-pcap-analyzer.

- Analyzes pcap/pcapng files for diagnosing slow network transfer, connection issues, VPN/IPsec negotiation, DNS and TLS errors, MTU/packet size problems, and session anomalies.
- Structured Markdown report with up to 16 detailed sections, including TCP, rate, retransmission, window issues, protocol anomalies, and ranked root causes.
- Dynamic report sections appear based on detected patterns (e.g., DNS, TLS, IKE, MTU issues).
- Requires Python 3 and scapy; entry point is scripts/pcap_analyze.py.
- Read-only and privacy-focused: only analyzes user-supplied files, never scans or modifies files automatically.
